kember_method_area_implementation.evidence: The complete tracked v1 tree has no code directory, raw surface, or label input. Its notebook loads precomputed ant_mm, body_mm, and post_mm fields. The local Kember method therefore records its adaptation explicitly: it sums actual HippUnfold native per-vertex surface-area values in mm^2 after a separately auditable label transfer.

metric_roles.primary: absolute system surface area in mm^2
metric_roles.secondary_denominator: total native surface area within the valid native ROI
metric_roles.secondary_aggregation: arithmetic mean of left and right hemisphere fractions
metric_roles.interpretation: Absolute area aligns with the Kember surface-area endpoint; relative area is a secondary measure of within-hippocampus spatial allocation.

known_output_contract.hemisphere_aggregation: combined fields equal the arithmetic mean of their L/R fields within at most 0.000101 mm^2, consistent with CSV rounding

label_transfer.area_weighting_scope: coronal midthickness surfaces are supplied only for categorical-label transfer
label_transfer.area_measurement: sum the actual native HippUnfold surfareacorobl per-vertex metric in mm^2

kember_method_area_implementation.implementation_scope: The unified subject-level workflow has exactly two active methods: hcp151_template_matching and hcp151_fixed.
kember_method_area_implementation.no_per_subject_clustering: Group-specific clustering belongs only to external_group_atlas_analysis; kember_metrics has no clustering method.
